# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- New public extension-method features in the d20tek-functional project should be placed in the main D20Tek.Functional namespace for sync APIs and D20Tek.Functional.Async for async APIs, mirroring existing file organization (e.g., FunctionalExtensions.cs / Async/FunctionalAsyncExtensions.cs), and each new public feature should include exhaustive unit tests, a CHANGELOG entry, and an update to docs/api-reference-core.md.
